single_feature.name: Position of the principal rounded body relative to the continuing upright/slanted course
single_feature.body_selector: Start with the certified whole construction bound by the supplied focal anchors. Select a rounded contour with an observable paper pocket only when its identity as the sole relevant rounded body is unambiguous within that construction. A second plausible bowl or return pocket prevents selection; no alphabetical identity, assumed segmentation, closure, baseline, bbox center or size threshold resolves that competition.

categories.BODY_AT_UPPER_END_WITH_LOWER_RETURN: Positive only when a uniquely selected rounded body has an observable joined upright/slanted course continuing below it and returning lower in the same construction.
categories.LOWER_LEFT_BODY_WITH_COURSE_ABOVE: Positive only when a uniquely selected rounded body lies to the left and lower than an observable joined upright/slanted course that extends above it.
categories.UNKNOWN: Principal body unclear; competing multiple bowls; both positive arrangements; neither arrangement; topology or owner assignment needed; required extent cropped. Absence of one arrangement does not establish the other.

single_feature.negative_requirement: A rejected category requires absent positive relational evidence after unambiguous body selection, or positively observed incompatible placement. It never implies the opposite category. With ambiguous selection, both category decisions remain UNKNOWN.

scientific_record.coordinate_convention: Approximate visual crop-local x,y annotations on the original raster, origin upper left, y increases downward. These locate observed ink/paper, not measured cut points, thresholds, exact closures or body-selector criteria. Dimensions were integrity checks only.

single_feature_rule.name: Position of principal rounded body relative to continuing upright/slanted course
single_feature_rule.learning_status: UNAVAILABLE; conditional rule recorded, no certified prototype association
single_feature_rule.body_selector: First identify the previously certified whole focal construction using the approved focal anchors. Select its single independently identifiable rounded body by a visibly curving ink contour and adjacent paper pocket. Do not use a readable glyph, source/card identity, image center, row preference, body-size cutoff, exact closure, assumed baseline, or an arbitrary cut of a continuous stroke. If the anchors and visible contours leave competing body or focal-construction candidates, abstain.

positive_arrangements.BODY_AT_UPPER_END_WITH_COURSE_BELOW: A uniquely selected rounded body is visibly at the upper end of its joined upright/slanted course, and the same continuing course is independently visible below the body into a lower return. The above/below relation must be visible without requiring exact closure or topology reconstruction.
positive_arrangements.BODY_LOWER_LEFT_WITH_COURSE_ABOVE: A uniquely selected rounded body lies to the lower left of its joined upright/slanted course, and that course is independently visible extending above the body. This must be positively seen; failure to establish the first arrangement does not establish this one.

single_feature_rule.negative: An arrangement is unsupported when its required body identity, join, relative placement, or continuing extent lacks positive visible support. Unsupported does not imply the opposite category.
single_feature_rule.UNKNOWN: Both arrangements, neither arrangement, uncertain principal body or focal construction, competing multiple bowls, topology needed to decide, or cropped required extent. UNKNOWN supplies no prototype/category assignment.

controlling_qualification.concrete_failure: Within the certified P02 whole construction, an upper rounded part and a lower rounded return each have a visible paper pocket. Selecting the upper part as principal would allow one relation; selecting the lower part could allow the other. The preregistered feature supplies no independent selector that licenses choosing between them. A reports this even while accepting the whole focal construction. Thus no reproducible two-reference separation was learned.
controlling_qualification.logical_scope: This is a failed operational-discriminator proposal, not a physical counterexample to every possible body-placement model, a class mismatch, or a falsification of historical membership. It does not negate the earlier different transition-feature result.
controlling_qualification.B_y_qualification: P01 packet explicitly supplies reader-A local y33 while reader-B Y is UNKNOWN. B chose not to use A Y and therefore gives a narrower focal-binding abstention. B statement about x-only bindings must not be generalized to absence of all available Y. No rescore or new body selection is made; A P02 ambiguity independently suffices to fail the gate.
